question: Who was appointed Chief Justice of the Calcutta High Court in May 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is__** T. S. Sivagnanam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **T. S. Sivagnanam:-**

 
 
• He is a highly respected judge who has served in various capacities in the Indian judiciary.
 
• **He was appointed as the Chief Justice of the Calcutta High Court in May 2023, and he is expected to serve with distinction in this role.**
